Routines for calm handling
The purpose of this section is to describe how the desk handles it

Calm Handling and Transfer Standards

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways must keep every arriving and departing animal under steady, low-stress care. Staff are to speak softly, move at an even pace, and keep carriers level while they are checked, tagged, and passed to the ground team. Sudden noise, crowding, and unnecessary handling are to be avoided. If a traveler appears anxious, staff should give clear reassurance and keep instructions brief and orderly.

When a carrier is accepted, it is to be inspected for secure latches, clean ventilation, and visible travel labels. Any concern about welfare, containment, or fit for travel must be reported at once to the senior coordinator before further movement takes place. The desk must not promise a handoff, boarding, or lounge access that has not been confirmed through the proper service channel. If a pet needs water, rest, or quiet, the request should be directed to the appropriate support area without delay.

The desk is to treat each animal as a passenger in care, not as baggage. Employees must keep the lane clear, use both hands when lifting where safe, and ask the ground team for support if a carrier is awkward or the path is crowded. A calm approach is expected even when schedules are busy. Travelers should be guided with courtesy, and any special instruction from the travel record is to be followed exactly.

For service notes that affect lounge access or lounge supervision, the desk shall rely on the approved entry already recorded in the system. <<FACT F021>> The same rule applies to any note that changes the movement of a pet through the lounge or transfer corridor. <<FACT F002>> Staff must keep these entries confidential and act only on the instructions already issued through the service record.

If there is uncertainty about animal comfort, equipment, or transfer handling, contact the senior coordinator immediately.
